text:
slack/devex/1789999999-ps-curl-envvar-rename.json

anya: Quick note — quickstart README cURL example is breaking for folks on PowerShell. It uses single quotes so $REDWOOD_API_KEY doesn't expand. Also found one sample using REDWOOD_ADMIN_KEY which is inconsistent. Getting onboarding tickets.

mike: Repro'd on Windows pwsh. Failing example:

```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"input":"yo"}'
```

pwsh treats single quotes literally and won't expand env vars.

tara: Proposed fixes: 1) show POSIX and PowerShell variants, 2) standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY in all language snippets, 3) add a one-line "terminal gotchas" note in quickstart. Example PowerShell alternative:

```powershell
$body = @{ input = 'yo' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" } -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
```

mike: Also flag in changelog that REDWOOD_ADMIN_KEY is deprecated/renamed so support can cite it. I'll open a small PR with the two curl forms + env var alignment.

anya: And let's clarify retry defaults in the quickstart troubleshooting—Node defaults to retries off so call that out and link to SDK retry docs.

devex-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2890 and draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 (assigned to @mike)

mike: Will push the PR today and ping support once merged. :thumbsup:
